## The 2026-11-03 legs: one card (GPU-8e3f74b9), six containers

- Under runc, vLLM 0.29.0 is at **1.018**. Under gVisor it is at **0.736** (runsc-20260914.0, driver 580.95.05), **0.755** (runsc-20260914.0, driver 610.57.04), **0.744** (runsc-20261026.0, driver 610.57.04): every gVisor build and driver tested.
- Under runsc-20260914.0, driver 580.95.05, **0.30.0** gives **1.040** [1.022, 1.058].
- Under runsc-20260914.0, driver 580.95.05, **0.29.0 + F046 pin** gives **0.726** [0.715, 0.738].
- What gVisor costs vLLM 0.29.0 against runc: graph arm 30%, eager arm 4% (mean over the gVisor 0.29.0 legs).
- Graph-arm GPU utilisation: **61.9--63.2%** in the deficit sessions, against 90.0--92.3% at parity; SM clock 2020--2028 MHz against 1610--1893; power 66.4--68.0 W against 69.8--70.2; power-capped 0.61--0.79 of samples against 0.96--0.96. The deficit graph arm clocks higher, draws less and is idle about a third of the time: the GPU is waiting, not throttled.
- Graph-arm CV under gVisor: 0.91--1.73%, against 3.73--13.92% in Modal's deficit sessions. The ratio reproduces; the dispersion does not.
